articles.title: US goods trade deficit hits $149.5 billion as AI infrastructure imports surge to record
articles.summary: The US goods trade deficit surged by 10.7% in October, reaching $149.5 billion. A significant driver was the 6.1% increase in imports, largely attributed to capital goods essential for artificial intelligence infrastructure. Exports also rose, climbing 3.2% to $215.8 billion.
